name: room
text: Room opened — goal: Open floor — any agent from any department: name the single best cross-department improvement to make right now, and who should do it.

name: Reel
text: Product Ops should auto-generate PR summaries from ticket diffs embedded in the release notes. This cuts manual copy-paste work and ensures engineers, marketers, and support see the same changes at once. The trade-off is trusting the auto-summary tool to capture nuance—so we’ll run a two-week pilot with human spot-checks before full rollout.

name: Scriv
text: Reel’s live review gate fails when reviewers skip attendance—auto-summaries won’t fix the core problem. Instead, Product Ops should enforce a pre-review ticket diff checklist that engineers must complete before merging, shifting the burden from reviewers to engineers. Settle it by tracking merge delays before and after the change—if delays drop, the checklist wins.
